catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class observes a mavros_msgs/State topic. The motion classes are commands, not observations, and a resource read is not a capability. The package uses an x-cap read with an inline output schema for the connected, armed and mode fields.

No catalogue class observes a geometry_msgs/PoseStamped local-position topic. cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 is a robot.arm command in millimetres with a reached output, not a MAVROS observation, so an x-cap read with an inline position schema is used.

No catalogue class requests a MAVROS flight mode. cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 is a bounded linear/angular velocity command and does not map to a SetMode custom_mode value, so the fixed GUIDED request uses an x-cap invoke.

No catalogue class arms a flight controller. cap.device.configure.v1 writes named resource-state parameters, not a CommandBool service request, so the fixed value=true arm request uses an x-cap invoke.

No catalogue class commands a takeoff altitude. cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 is only for robot.arm and uses millimetres and inverse kinematics; cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 is a velocity command. The MAVROS CommandTOL takeoff has an altitude and a success flag, so an x-cap with an operator-required altitude is used.

No catalogue class publishes a PoseStamped position setpoint. cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 is a velocity command; cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 is robot.arm-only in millimetres and reports a reached position. The rosbridge publication is one message, so the x-cap reports published/confirmed and never claims final-position attainment.
No catalogue class requests a return-to-launch flight mode; the fixed SetMode custom_mode RTL request has no catalogue equivalent, so an x-cap invoke is used.
The ordinary LAND SetMode request returns mode_sent, not touchdown or cessation. It remains an ordinary latched action and is not an estop or safe-state binding.

notes:
BLOCKED: the ArduPilot/MAVROS client profile preserves state/pose reads, GUIDED, arm, takeoff, position, RTL and ordinary LAND requests, but the selected external graph provides no proven independent stop. LAND mode_sent is request acknowledgement; a controlled reply can arrive while state still reports an armed flying vehicle. LAND is no longer an estop binding, safe-state action or latch exemption. The stock stop receipt is failed with safe_state_achieved=false. ROS 2 PoseStamped uses sec/nanosec; pose fields are not mislabeled as north/east axes without deployed MAVROS-frame proof. Position and altitude are operator-required and the example values are not device limits. One published setpoint is not the mission's repeated stream or arrival. The zero timestamp remains a wire placeholder. The repository supplies clients and launch configuration, not the external controller implementation. R2 risk is retained; the documented RC procedure does not establish a tested independent physical stop. No disarm, RC override, mission upload or flight-state safety certification is added.
